quests.title: Mending the Welcome Table
quests.npc_look: elderly woman, silver bun, green shawl, cream skirt, woven basket
intro: The welcome table has a wobble. Every new adventurer sets a cup on it, and every cup leans toward the floor.
Bring me 12 stump bark from Stumpkin in Whisperwheat Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the stump bark. Take your time on the trail.
complete: That bark will make sturdy shims. A feast should challenge your appetite, not your balance.

quests.title: A Ribbon at Each Place
quests.npc_look: elderly woman, silver bun, green shawl, cream skirt, woven basket
intro: The table stands straight, but the festival ribbons have wandered off with the hogs.
Bring me 16 pig ribbon from Bristle Hog in Whisperwheat Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the pig ribbon. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Pink suits the tables beautifully. The hogs can choose their own decorations next year.

quests.title: Caps for the Rain
quests.npc_look: elderly woman, silver bun, green shawl, cream skirt, woven basket
intro: A shower is coming. Broad mushroom caps will shelter the bread while the ovens cool.
Bring me 20 mushroom cap from Puffspore in Whisperwheat Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Dry bread, dry benches, and a sky doing its best to interfere. We are ready.

quests.title: One Quiet Supper
quests.npc_look: elderly woman, silver bun, green shawl, cream skirt, woven basket
intro: Jellops are bouncing along the serving path. Clear a little room so the youngest travelers can carry their bowls.
Defeat 24 Jellop in Whisperwheat Fields.
quests.progress: There are still Jellop along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The first chair is yours. Take this vest; there is always another newcomer who needs a welcome.

quests.title: A Lesson That Lasts
quests.npc_look: bespectacled scholar man, brown vest, blue scarf, book
intro: Our first-trail guide washes away in the rain. Shell powder makes ink cling to the page.
Bring me 12 snail shell from Pebble Snail in Snailgrass Path.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the snail shell. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Now the directions will survive their first puddle. That is more than my old boots managed.

quests.title: Mind the Blue Ones
quests.npc_look: bespectacled scholar man, brown vest, blue scarf, book
intro: The new trail markers lead straight through a crowd of Azure Snails. Help me make a safe practice route.
Defeat 16 Azure Snail in Snailgrass Path.
quests.progress: There are still Azure Snail along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: A clear path is a better first lesson than a surprise shell to the ankle.

quests.title: A Cover Against Drizzle
quests.npc_look: bespectacled scholar man, brown vest, blue scarf, book
intro: The pages are finished. A pressed mushroom cap will make a pleasantly waterproof cover.
Bring me 20 mushroom cap from Puffspore in Snailgrass Path.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: It smells faintly of the woods. A guidebook ought to.

quests.title: The Last Field Lesson
quests.npc_look: bespectacled scholar man, brown vest, blue scarf, book
intro: One final stretch needs clearing before the next class arrives. Leave the shore flowers standing, please.
Defeat 24 Ember Snail in Snailgrass Path.
quests.progress: There are still Ember Snail along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The new class will find a kinder trail. Keep this gear as proof that you helped write their first chapter.

quests.title: Light for the Late Ferry
quests.npc_look: weathered harbor man, blue cap, teal coat, rope coil
intro: The late ferry follows our red harbor lantern. Its reflector cracked in last night's wind.
Bring me 12 snail shell from Ember Snail in Saltwind Road.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the snail shell. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Polished shells will scatter the light across the water. A little patience makes a bright beacon.

quests.title: Flags Above the Pier
quests.npc_look: weathered harbor man, blue cap, teal coat, rope coil
intro: The hogs carried off our signal ribbons. The harbor looks as though it has forgotten how to wave.
Bring me 16 pig ribbon from Bristle Hog in Saltwind Road.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the pig ribbon. Take your time on the trail.
complete: There we are: three flags for arrival, one for hot tea. The last signal is unofficial.

quests.title: A Seal Against Salt
quests.npc_look: weathered harbor man, blue cap, teal coat, rope coil
intro: Salt spray gets into every lantern seam. Bring clear gel so I can seal the new reflector.
Bring me 20 slime goo from Jellop in Saltwind Road.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the slime goo. Take your time on the trail.
complete: No more damp wick. The keeper will sleep better, and so will the ferry crew.

quests.title: A Clear Walk Home
quests.npc_look: weathered harbor man, blue cap, teal coat, rope coil
intro: Mushrooms are crowding the approach from Saltwind Road. The passengers deserve a clear walk home.
Defeat 24 Tangerine Cap in Saltwind Road.
quests.progress: There are still Tangerine Cap along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: There is the ferry bell. Take this, and join us when the gangplank settles.

quests.title: The Observatory Shutters
quests.npc_look: elderly mage man, navy robe, blue pointed hat, silver beard, staff
intro: The canopy observatory is opening again. First, its shutters need bark that can bend with the branches.
Bring me 18 stump bark from Gloom Stump in Canopy Stair.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the stump bark. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Flexible and strong. The trees have been solving building problems longer than we have.

quests.title: A Softer Telescope Shade
quests.npc_look: elderly mage man, navy robe, blue pointed hat, silver beard, staff
intro: Dew keeps settling on the lens. A broad cap will shelter it without hiding the northern stars.
Bring me 22 mushroom cap from Mossy Cap in Canopy Stair.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A telescope wearing a mushroom hat. I will call it practical and refuse further questions.

quests.title: Steady the Star Glass
quests.npc_look: elderly mage man, navy robe, blue pointed hat, silver beard, staff
intro: The lens mount rattles whenever the branch sways. Clear gel will cushion its little brass cradle.
Bring me 26 slime goo from Jellop in Canopy Stair.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the slime goo. Take your time on the trail.
complete: There: not a tremble. Even the faint stars should hold still long enough to count.

quests.title: Opening Night
quests.npc_look: elderly mage man, navy robe, blue pointed hat, silver beard, staff
intro: Stumpkins have gathered beneath the observation steps. Clear the entrance before our evening visitors arrive.
Defeat 30 Stumpkin in Canopy Stair.
quests.progress: There are still Stumpkin along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: Our first constellation is visible. This is for you; the view is for everyone.

quests.title: A New Bell Handle
quests.npc_look: bearded blacksmith man, dark apron, copper goggles, lowered hammer
intro: The ridge bell warns miners when the weather turns. Its handle split clean through this morning.
Bring me 18 stump bark from Hatchet Stump in Emberstep Ridge.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the stump bark. Take your time on the trail.
complete: This grain will hold. A warning bell should not need a warning of its own.

quests.title: The Clapper Pin
quests.npc_look: bearded blacksmith man, dark apron, copper goggles, lowered hammer
intro: A tough tusk pin will keep the clapper from slipping in its mount. The ridge boars have plenty to spare.
Bring me 22 boar tusk from Tusker Boar in Emberstep Ridge.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the boar tusk. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A snug fit, and not a scrap wasted. That is good smithing.

quests.title: Clear the Bell Path
quests.npc_look: bearded blacksmith man, dark apron, copper goggles, lowered hammer
intro: The repair crew cannot reach the bell while stumps crowd the ridge path. Give them some working room.
Defeat 26 Gloom Stump in Emberstep Ridge.
quests.progress: There are still Gloom Stump along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The crew made it up with all their tools and most of their sandwiches.

quests.title: The First Ring
quests.npc_look: bearded blacksmith man, dark apron, copper goggles, lowered hammer
intro: We need a final bundle of dry bark for the sheltered firing pit. Then the repaired collar can be tempered.
Bring me 30 stump bark from Stumpkin in Emberstep Ridge.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the stump bark. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Hear that? The whole ridge can. Wear this with the thanks of everyone who works above the clouds.

quests.title: Ink That Keeps Its Word
quests.npc_look: young courier woman, plum hood, brown satchel
intro: Rain turned an entire delivery bag into one large blot. Inkling residue will help set a fresh batch of ink.
Bring me 18 ectoplasm from Inkling in Gutterlane.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The address stays put when wet. That is an excellent quality in an address.

quests.title: The Dry Delivery Route
quests.npc_look: young courier woman, plum hood, brown satchel
intro: A gator is treating the gutter crossing as a private doorstep. Clear the route before the evening post.
Defeat 22 Swamp Gator in Gutterlane.
quests.progress: There are still Swamp Gator along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The letters will reach the upper stairs without acquiring tooth marks.

quests.title: Caps for the Post Box
quests.npc_look: young courier woman, plum hood, brown satchel
intro: The box above Gutterlane has lost its roof. A broad cap will keep tomorrow's letters dry.
Bring me 26 mushroom cap from Horned Cap in Gutterlane.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A fine little roof. Please do not tell the landlord we improved the building.

quests.title: The Last Undelivered Letter
quests.npc_look: young courier woman, plum hood, brown satchel
intro: Wisps are gathering where the night couriers change bags. Help me keep that corner bright and safe.
Defeat 30 Wisp Wraith in Gutterlane.
quests.progress: There are still Wisp Wraith along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The last letter was an invitation to supper. It would have been a shame to lose it. This is yours.

quests.title: A Careful Little Sample
quests.npc_look: alchemist woman, silver hair, violet robe, green vial
intro: The root lanterns are dimming. A measured sample of rotcap spores will tell me whether damp is the cause.
Bring me 18 mushroom cap from Rotcap in Rootcellar Depths.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Damp, as suspected. The spores are troublesome, but they are not keeping secrets.

quests.title: Warmth in the Wick
quests.npc_look: alchemist woman, silver hair, violet robe, green vial
intro: A boar-tusk wick holder can withstand the lantern's hotter cleansing flame. Keep your gloves on while gathering it.
Bring me 22 boar tusk from Cinder Boar in Rootcellar Depths.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the boar tusk. Take your time on the trail.
complete: These will last through a dozen winters. I shall label the drawer before I forget what they are.

quests.title: Room for the Lamplighter
quests.npc_look: alchemist woman, silver hair, violet robe, green vial
intro: The lamplighter needs clear footing under the low roots. Send the horned caps away from the work path.
Defeat 26 Horned Cap in Rootcellar Depths.
quests.progress: There are still Horned Cap along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: He has reached the last post. There is already a warm line of light through the hollow.

quests.title: The Gentle Glow
quests.npc_look: alchemist woman, silver hair, violet robe, green vial
intro: A trace of wisp essence will soften the flame so it does not trouble the nesting birds.
Bring me 30 ectoplasm from Wisp Wraith in Rootcellar Depths.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Warm light, quiet nests, and a safe road home. A good evening's work deserves good gear.

quests.title: The Missing Picnic Pegs
quests.npc_look: plump baker woman, white bonnet, cream apron, bread basket
intro: Our picnic cloths need new pegs before the tide wind arrives. Clean crab claws make surprisingly good clips.
Bring me 18 crab claw from Reef Snapper in Sunpetal Strand.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the crab claw. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Firm enough for a sea breeze, gentle enough for linen. I wish all kitchen tools were so agreeable.

quests.title: Shade for the Cakes
quests.npc_look: plump baker woman, white bonnet, cream apron, bread basket
intro: The little cakes will melt in the afternoon sun. Broad orange caps will make cheerful shades.
Bring me 22 mushroom cap from Tangerine Cap in Sunpetal Strand.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: They look like tiny parasols. The children may remember the shades longer than the cakes.

quests.title: A Jar for Every Jam
quests.npc_look: plump baker woman, white bonnet, cream apron, bread basket
intro: The jam jars need a fresh seal for the walk along the strand. Clear gel will do nicely.
Bring me 26 slime goo from Jellop in Sunpetal Strand.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the slime goo. Take your time on the trail.
complete: No leaking jam today. My apron may finally get an uneventful afternoon.

quests.title: The Picnic Path
quests.npc_look: plump baker woman, white bonnet, cream apron, bread basket
intro: Clear the last stretch of the strand while I carry out the baskets. Leave room for the tide to come in.
Defeat 30 Ember Snail in Sunpetal Strand.
quests.progress: There are still Ember Snail along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: Everything is ready. Take this, find a comfortable rock, and save some room for a second cake.

quests.title: A Quiet Launch
quests.npc_look: bespectacled scholar man, slate vest, gold scarf, book
intro: The weather kite has been grounded since the apes took over its launch stairs. Help me reclaim the steps.
Defeat 18 Canopy Ape in Cloudspire Steps.
quests.progress: There are still Canopy Ape along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: A clear launch at last. I have missed hearing the kite string sing.

quests.title: A Patch for the Tail
quests.npc_look: bespectacled scholar man, slate vest, gold scarf, book
intro: The kite's tail tore on a branch. Pressed cap fibers make a light patch that will not pull it sideways.
Bring me 22 mushroom cap from Mossy Cap in Cloudspire Steps.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Light as a leaf and much less likely to fly away on its own.

quests.title: The Knot Keeper
quests.npc_look: bespectacled scholar man, slate vest, gold scarf, book
intro: Cloud damp loosens every knot. A thin coat of gel will hold the weather line without making it heavy.
Bring me 26 slime goo from Jellop in Cloudspire Steps.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the slime goo. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Steady line, steady readings. We may finally know whether tomorrow calls for cloaks.

quests.title: Two Feathers to Balance
quests.npc_look: bespectacled scholar man, slate vest, gold scarf, book
intro: A matched pair of feathers will balance the kite's little wind vane. Twinheads leave such useful souvenirs.
Bring me 30 feather from Twinhead Birk in Cloudspire Steps.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the feather. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The kite is home above the clouds. This is your share of the weather office's small but grateful budget.

quests.title: Reading the Frost
quests.npc_look: winter warden man, fur-trimmed blue coat, white hair
intro: The wayhouse hearth has gone cold. Ice caught in the flue will tell us where the draft is failing.
Bring me 18 ice shard from Frost Cub in Whitefang Pass.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ice shard. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The frost is heaviest at the bend. We have found the trouble without losing a chimney brush.

quests.title: A Safe Wood Run
quests.npc_look: winter warden man, fur-trimmed blue coat, white hair
intro: The wood carriers cannot cross the pass while the wolves hold the narrow stretch. Open a path for them.
Defeat 22 Rime Wolf in Whitefang Pass.
quests.progress: There are still Rime Wolf along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The sleds are moving again. A warm hearth begins with a safe journey.

quests.title: The Last Frozen Collar
quests.npc_look: winter warden man, fur-trimmed blue coat, white hair
intro: Snowhorn ice is dense enough to brace the flue while its new collar sets. Bring only what you can carry safely.
Bring me 26 ice shard from Snowhorn in Whitefang Pass.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ice shard. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A strong brace. I had rather hoped the repair would not require my standing on the roof.

quests.title: Keep the Hearth Road Open
quests.npc_look: winter warden man, fur-trimmed blue coat, white hair
intro: One more sweep of the wayhouse road will let the evening travelers reach us before the snow thickens.
Defeat 30 Frost Cub in Whitefang Pass.
quests.progress: There are still Frost Cub along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: There is a fire in the hearth again. Your gear should keep a little of that warmth with you.

quests.title: A Missing Minute
quests.chain: The Clock That Took a Holiday
quests.npc_look: engineer woman, brass goggles, teal overalls, wrench
intro: The town clock has stopped at teatime. A pleasant hour, but we cannot keep it forever.
Bring me 18 gear cog from Tick Sentinel in Clockwork Warrens.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the gear cog. Take your time on the trail.
complete: These cogs still have a good deal of honest work in them.

quests.title: Padding for the Pendulum
quests.chain: The Clock That Took a Holiday
quests.npc_look: engineer woman, brass goggles, teal overalls, wrench
intro: The pendulum knocks against its housing. Soft stuffing from the wandering toys will quiet it.
Bring me 22 cursed doll from Stitched Bruin in Clockwork Warrens.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the cursed doll. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A gentle tick instead of a clang. The neighbors may forgive me yet.

quests.title: Clear the Service Landing
quests.chain: The Clock That Took a Holiday
quests.npc_look: engineer woman, brass goggles, teal overalls, wrench
intro: Clockworks are blocking the maintenance landing. I need enough room to carry a very stubborn pendulum.
Defeat 26 Grim Clockwork in Clockwork Warrens.
quests.progress: There are still Grim Clockwork along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The landing is clear. The pendulum remains stubborn, but it is now my problem.

quests.title: The Minute Hand Returns
quests.chain: The Clock That Took a Holiday
quests.npc_look: engineer woman, brass goggles, teal overalls, wrench
intro: The clock's guide crystal has faded. A few bright fragments will help its hand find the right minute.
Bring me 30 star fragment from Phantom Timepiece in Clockwork Warrens.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the star fragment. Take your time on the trail.
complete: It is no longer teatime. A pity, but a well-earned one. Take this for getting us moving.

quests.title: The Station Gate
quests.npc_look: bearded blacksmith man, navy apron, copper goggles, lowered hammer
intro: The station gate jammed while the school group was crossing. We need sound replacement cogs.
Bring me 18 gear cog from Tick Sentinel in Starfall Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the gear cog. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Good teeth on these. A gate ought to open without a debate.

quests.title: A Bed for the Rails
quests.npc_look: bearded blacksmith man, navy apron, copper goggles, lowered hammer
intro: The gate post is settling. Firm stone packing will stop the rails from twisting with it.
Bring me 22 golem rock from Rubble Golem in Starfall Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the golem rock. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Solid footing. That is half of every repair, and nearly all of every sensible plan.

quests.title: The Work Crew's Way
quests.npc_look: bearded blacksmith man, navy apron, copper goggles, lowered hammer
intro: Clear the approach while the crew raises the post. Nobody needs a clockwork inspecting the scaffolding.
Defeat 26 Grim Clockwork in Starfall Fields.
quests.progress: There are still Grim Clockwork along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The post is straight again. The foreman has stopped pretending it always was.

quests.title: The Brass Seal
quests.npc_look: bearded blacksmith man, navy apron, copper goggles, lowered hammer
intro: Heat-resistant stone will line the little casting mould for the new gate seal.
Bring me 30 golem rock from Obsidian Golem in Starfall Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the golem rock. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A gate that keeps its promise: open for travelers, closed against the night. This is for your part in it.

quests.title: The Lantern Walk
quests.npc_look: young lantern boy, yellow raincoat, brown boots, small lantern
intro: The festival lanterns are ready, but the apes keep shaking the path ropes. Will you make the walk quiet?
Defeat 18 Canopy Ape in Foxfire Hollow.
quests.progress: There are still Canopy Ape along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: Now people can look at the lanterns instead of their feet.

quests.title: A Little Green Roof
quests.npc_look: young lantern boy, yellow raincoat, brown boots, small lantern
intro: I made a lantern for someone who cannot come home this year. It needs a cap roof to survive the dew.
Bring me 22 mushroom cap from Mossy Cap in Foxfire Hollow.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Green is her favorite. I think she would approve.

quests.title: A Light That Travels
quests.npc_look: young lantern boy, yellow raincoat, brown boots, small lantern
intro: The storyteller says wisp essence helps a lantern glow through mist. Just enough for one small wick.
Bring me 26 ectoplasm from Wisp Wraith in Foxfire Hollow.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: It shines without smoke. Perhaps it will be seen from farther away.

quests.title: A Place Above the Valley
quests.npc_look: young lantern boy, yellow raincoat, brown boots, small lantern
intro: The highest hanging post is crowded with horned caps. Clear a place for our last lantern.
Defeat 30 Horned Cap in Foxfire Hollow.
quests.progress: There are still Horned Cap along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: I named it Safe Journey. Take this; I wanted the person who helped to have something that lasts.

quests.title: The Viewing Window
quests.npc_look: traveling merchant man, burgundy coat, broad hat, travel pack
intro: The reef viewing window is loose. Strong little claw clips will hold its frame during repairs.
Bring me 18 crab claw from Reef Snapper in Coral Cathedral.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the crab claw. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Visitors will be able to lean close without making me nervous.

quests.title: Living Stone Supports
quests.npc_look: traveling merchant man, burgundy coat, broad hat, travel pack
intro: The window needs supports that belong in salt water. Reef stone will weather gently alongside the coral.
Bring me 22 golem rock from Coral Golem in Coral Cathedral.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the golem rock. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A repair should suit its home. These stones look as though they have always been here.

quests.title: The Clear-Water Seal
quests.npc_look: traveling merchant man, burgundy coat, broad hat, travel pack
intro: A thin inkling-resin seal will keep sand out of the viewing groove. Bring a clean sample.
Bring me 26 ectoplasm from Tide Inkling in Coral Cathedral.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The glass slides smoothly. No more grinding sound to frighten the little fish.

quests.title: The First Visitors
quests.npc_look: traveling merchant man, burgundy coat, broad hat, travel pack
intro: Clear the approach while I lead the first visitors down. They have waited all season to see this reef.
Defeat 30 Gloomfin in Coral Cathedral.
quests.progress: There are still Gloomfin along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: One child has already called it a garden with fins. Keep this, with the reef keeper's thanks.

quests.title: The Broken Waymarker
quests.npc_look: ranger woman, auburn braid, forest-green cloak, bow on back
intro: A drake nest has appeared above the road. Blue scales will make a marker travelers can see without disturbing it.
Bring me 18 scale from Azure Drake in Wyrmwood Reach.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the scale. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Bright enough for the bend, quiet enough for a nest. That is what we need.

quests.title: The Warm Stone Crossing
quests.npc_look: ranger woman, auburn braid, forest-green cloak, bow on back
intro: Crimson drakes are gathering at the only safe crossing. Open a narrow way for the pack carriers.
Defeat 22 Crimson Drake in Wyrmwood Reach.
quests.progress: There are still Crimson Drake along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The carriers are through. We can share a mountain without sharing every stepping stone.

quests.title: A Cool Shelter Roof
quests.npc_look: ranger woman, auburn braid, forest-green cloak, bow on back
intro: Pale scales will keep the little roadside shelter cool when the south wind turns warm.
Bring me 26 scale from Frost Drake in Wyrmwood Reach.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the scale. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A roof fit for a place of rest. The drakes have taught us something useful again.

quests.title: The Wind Bell
quests.npc_look: ranger woman, auburn braid, forest-green cloak, bow on back
intro: Soft feathers will keep the shelter's wind bell from startling the hatchlings overhead.
Bring me 30 feather from Twinhead Birk in Wyrmwood Reach.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the feather. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The bell is gentle, the road is marked, and the nest is quiet. Take this for a considerate journey.

quests.title: Room Beneath the Boughs
quests.npc_look: plump baker woman, white bonnet, lavender apron, bread basket
intro: The festival tables belong under the peach trees. The apes seem to have booked every branch above them.
Defeat 18 Canopy Ape in Peachwind Terrace.
quests.progress: There are still Canopy Ape along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The branches are quiet. We can set the tables without wearing the decorations.

quests.title: The Basket Lining
quests.npc_look: plump baker woman, white bonnet, lavender apron, bread basket
intro: The old picnic baskets need soft lining. Clean stuffing from the wandering bears will protect the fruit.
Bring me 22 cursed doll from Stitched Bruin in Peachwind Terrace.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the cursed doll. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Soft enough for the ripest peach. I shall save the prettiest basket for the oldest guest.

quests.title: A Brush for the Glaze
quests.npc_look: plump baker woman, white bonnet, lavender apron, bread basket
intro: A feather brush will spread the honey glaze without bruising the little cakes.
Bring me 26 feather from Twinhead Birk in Peachwind Terrace.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the feather. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A very fine brush. I promise it will be washed before any honey is involved.

quests.title: The Evening Basket Run
quests.npc_look: plump baker woman, white bonnet, lavender apron, bread basket
intro: Clear the terrace path so the baskets can reach the outer tables before the evening wind.
Defeat 30 Rime Wolf in Peachwind Terrace.
quests.progress: There are still Rime Wolf along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: There is a place set for you. Until supper, take this as a small taste of our gratitude.

quests.title: A Path to the Sluice
quests.npc_look: farmer woman, straw hat, ochre overalls, seed pouch
intro: The reed beds are drying at the far end. Clear the sluice path so I can find what is blocking the water.
Defeat 18 Swamp Gator in Reedwater Marsh.
quests.progress: There are still Swamp Gator along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The gate is jammed, but the channel is sound. That is a kinder problem than I feared.

quests.title: A Filter of Fibers
quests.npc_look: farmer woman, straw hat, ochre overalls, seed pouch
intro: Pressed cap fibers will catch silt without starving the reeds of water.
Bring me 22 mushroom cap from Mossy Cap in Reedwater Marsh.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A clean little filter. The water is already running brighter.

quests.title: The Gate Seal
quests.npc_look: farmer woman, straw hat, ochre overalls, seed pouch
intro: The sluice collar needs flexible resin. Inkling residue will hold through wet and dry weather alike.
Bring me 26 ectoplasm from Inkling in Reedwater Marsh.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A seal that bends instead of cracking. The best repairs know how to give a little.

quests.title: Water Before Moonrise
quests.npc_look: farmer woman, straw hat, ochre overalls, seed pouch
intro: Clear the last channel bend while I open the gate. The night reeds need their first drink before moonrise.
Defeat 30 Wisp Wraith in Reedwater Marsh.
quests.progress: There are still Wisp Wraith along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: Hear them rustle? That is the sound we were missing. Take this for bringing it back.

quests.title: A Sunshade That Holds
quests.npc_look: traveling merchant man, indigo coat, broad hat, travel pack
intro: The caravan well has lost its sunshade ties. Tough lizard-hide strips will hold through the dry wind.
Bring me 18 lizard tail from Dune Lizard in Sunscar Dunes.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the lizard tail. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A little shade makes a long road feel shorter.

quests.title: Stones Around the Well
quests.npc_look: traveling merchant man, indigo coat, broad hat, travel pack
intro: The well rim is crumbling. Bring sound stone so small hands can reach the bucket safely.
Bring me 22 golem rock from Rubble Golem in Sunscar Dunes.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the golem rock. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A steady rim and no sharp edges. The children will find it easier now.

quests.title: The Water Carrier's Path
quests.npc_look: traveling merchant man, indigo coat, broad hat, travel pack
intro: The water carriers need the approach cleared. Even an empty pail feels heavy when a boar is arguing with it.
Defeat 26 Cinder Boar in Sunscar Dunes.
quests.progress: There are still Cinder Boar along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The first water cart has reached the shade. We can finally stop counting every cup.

quests.title: The Well's Little Flag
quests.npc_look: traveling merchant man, indigo coat, broad hat, travel pack
intro: A feather vane will show travelers where the windbreak begins. It need not be grand, only visible.
Bring me 30 feather from Twinhead Birk in Sunscar Dunes.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the feather. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The well is ready for the next caravan. Take this, and remember there is always a cup waiting here.

quests.title: The Uncracked Retort
quests.npc_look: alchemist woman, silver hair, deep navy robe, green vial
intro: The old still cracked while making anti-rust oil. Obsidian grit will strengthen its replacement.
Bring me 18 golem rock from Obsidian Golem in Glasscoil Works.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the golem rock. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A sturdy retort. This time I will warm it slowly and listen to my own advice.

quests.title: The Patient Stirrer
quests.npc_look: alchemist woman, silver hair, deep navy robe, green vial
intro: A slow stir is the secret to the mixture. The stirring clock needs a sound little gear.
Bring me 22 gear cog from Tick Sentinel in Glasscoil Works.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the gear cog. Take your time on the trail.
complete: One turn at a time. Alchemy rewards patience more often than it rewards explosions.

quests.title: The Last Measured Drop
quests.npc_look: alchemist woman, silver hair, deep navy robe, green vial
intro: A trace of shade essence keeps moisture from returning to treated metal. A trace, mind you.
Bring me 26 ectoplasm from Shade Wraith in Glasscoil Works.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The measure is right. No fumes, no fizz, and no need to apologize to the neighbors.

quests.title: A Clear Workshop Lane
quests.npc_look: alchemist woman, silver hair, deep navy robe, green vial
intro: Clear the lane while the cooled jars go to the bridge crew. They cannot carry glass around wandering stone.
Defeat 30 Rubble Golem in Glasscoil Works.
quests.progress: There are still Rubble Golem along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The bridge hinges will last another season. This is for the steadier pair of hands in today's work.

quests.title: A Quiet Archive Walk
quests.npc_look: serene monk, tan robe, blue sash, prayer beads
intro: The wardens repeat their old patrol through the reading court. Clear a path for the returning scribes.
Defeat 18 Memory Warden in Echoes of Tomorrow.
quests.progress: There are still Memory Warden along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The scribes are inside. An archive sounds healthier with pages turning.

quests.title: Stone for the Sundial
quests.npc_look: serene monk, tan robe, blue sash, prayer beads
intro: The courtyard sundial lost the stone that holds its face. Bring a piece that has weathered patient years.
Bring me 22 golem rock from Chrono Guardian in Echoes of Tomorrow.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the golem rock. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A strong base. Time may pass, but the dial need not wander with it.

quests.title: The Evening Mark
quests.npc_look: serene monk, tan robe, blue sash, prayer beads
intro: A star fragment will catch the last light and mark the hour the old keeper always set aside for visitors.
Bring me 26 star fragment from Gloam Sentinel in Echoes of Tomorrow.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the star fragment. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A small glimmer, exactly where he would have put it.

quests.title: The Doors at Dusk
quests.npc_look: serene monk, tan robe, blue sash, prayer beads
intro: Keep the approach clear while we open the archive doors for one evening of shared stories.
Defeat 30 Oblivion Monk in Echoes of Tomorrow.
quests.progress: There are still Oblivion Monk along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: We have kept the hour without trying to stop it. Take this, and spend your next one well.

quests.title: Shelter for the Offering
quests.npc_look: young shrine keeper woman, white robe, red sash, paper charm
intro: Rain found the offering shelf. A broad cap awning will keep the little paper wishes dry.
Bring me 18 mushroom cap from Tangerine Cap in Foxmoon Grove.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A humble roof for humble wishes. It is enough.

quests.title: The Bell Walk
quests.npc_look: young shrine keeper woman, white robe, red sash, paper charm
intro: Horned caps crowd the path to the hanging bells. Clear the way before the evening visitors arrive.
Defeat 22 Horned Cap in Foxmoon Grove.
quests.progress: There are still Horned Cap along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The path is open. Nobody should need a running start to bring a wish to the shrine.

quests.title: A Gentle Bell Light
quests.npc_look: young shrine keeper woman, white robe, red sash, paper charm
intro: Wisp essence will give the bell lantern a gentle flame that does not scorch the paper ribbons.
Bring me 26 ectoplasm from Wisp Wraith in Foxmoon Grove.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: It glows softly enough to leave the moon some work to do.

quests.title: The Last Little Awning
quests.npc_look: young shrine keeper woman, white robe, red sash, paper charm
intro: The outer wish stand needs a cover too. I would rather no one's hope be the one left in the rain.
Bring me 30 mushroom cap from Mossy Cap in Foxmoon Grove.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Every wish has a dry place now. This is a practical blessing for the road ahead.

quests.title: The Stall Sign Braces
quests.npc_look: young courier woman, dark green hood, brown satchel
intro: The night market signs have worked loose. Smooth bone braces will make them light but sturdy.
Bring me 18 bone fragment from Bonewalker in Ashmarket Rooftops.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the bone fragment. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The lettering is straight again. Our baker will be pleased to stop selling what looks like burnt soup.

quests.title: The Coal Cart Crossing
quests.npc_look: young courier woman, dark green hood, brown satchel
intro: Clear the cart crossing so the vendors can bring fuel to their little braziers.
Defeat 22 Cinder Boar in Ashmarket Rooftops.
quests.progress: There are still Cinder Boar along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: Warm stalls make a kinder market. The first kettle is already singing.

quests.title: Glass for the Night Lamps
quests.npc_look: young courier woman, dark green hood, brown satchel
intro: A thin coat of shade resin cuts the glare on the lamp glass. The late readers will thank us.
Bring me 26 ectoplasm from Shade Wraith in Ashmarket Rooftops.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Bright enough for prices, soft enough for tired eyes.

quests.title: One Last Delivery Round
quests.npc_look: young courier woman, dark green hood, brown satchel
intro: The signs are fixed and the lamps are lit. Clear my final delivery stretch, and we can both call it a night.
Defeat 30 Horned Cap in Ashmarket Rooftops.
quests.progress: There are still Horned Cap along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The last parcel is home. This was tucked into the courier fund for someone who earns it.

quests.title: The Watch Path
quests.npc_look: young shrine keeper woman, white robe, blue sash, paper charm
intro: The old watch changes at the same hour every night. Clear a path so we can tend its neglected memorial.
Defeat 18 Memory Warden in Silent Ramparts.
quests.progress: There are still Memory Warden along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: Thank you. A quiet path makes room for quiet thoughts.

quests.title: Ink for the Names
quests.npc_look: young shrine keeper woman, white robe, blue sash, paper charm
intro: A trace of temple essence will fix the faded names to fresh memorial paper.
Bring me 22 ectoplasm from Oblivion Monk in Silent Ramparts.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The names are legible again. They deserve to be read, not guessed.

quests.title: The Lantern Approach
quests.npc_look: young shrine keeper woman, white robe, blue sash, paper charm
intro: Wolves have gathered by the outer lanterns. Send them away while I replace the old wicks.
Defeat 26 Moonfang Lycan in Silent Ramparts.
quests.progress: There are still Moonfang Lycan along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The lanterns are ready. No one returning from the road will find the keep dark.

quests.title: The Bell's Small Pin
quests.npc_look: young shrine keeper woman, white robe, blue sash, paper charm
intro: A light bone pin will hold the memorial bell's worn hinge without changing its familiar sound.
Bring me 30 bone fragment from Bone Archer in Silent Ramparts.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the bone fragment. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The same clear note as before. Keep this, and carry the watch's thanks into the morning.

quests.title: The Shutter Hinges
quests.npc_look: engineer woman, brass goggles, rust-orange overalls, wrench
intro: Hollowlight Estate is opening its windows again. Light bone bushings will spare the old wooden hinges.
Bring me 18 bone fragment from Bonewalker in Hollowlight Estate.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the bone fragment. Take your time on the trail.
complete: They swing without a creak. The house sounds almost surprised.

quests.title: A Cap for the Vent
quests.npc_look: engineer woman, brass goggles, rust-orange overalls, wrench
intro: The kitchen vent needs a cover before we light the stove. A broad cap will keep the rain from following the smoke in.
Bring me 22 mushroom cap from Rotcap in Hollowlight Estate.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Smoke out, rain out. A kitchen should keep its priorities simple.

quests.title: Room for the Window Crew
quests.npc_look: engineer woman, brass goggles, rust-orange overalls, wrench
intro: Clear the front approach while the crew carries the cleaned windows inside.
Defeat 26 Shade Wraith in Hollowlight Estate.
quests.progress: There are still Shade Wraith along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: Every pane arrived whole. I am counting that as the finest sort of good fortune.

quests.title: The Hearth Lamp
quests.npc_look: engineer woman, brass goggles, rust-orange overalls, wrench
intro: A little wisp essence will wake the old welcome lamp. It used to shine for every visitor, even late ones.
Bring me 30 ectoplasm from Wisp Wraith in Hollowlight Estate.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: There it is, in the front window. This is for helping a tired house look glad to see people again.

quests.title: The Surveyors' Path
quests.npc_look: ranger woman, auburn braid, blue cloak, bow on back
intro: The trail surveyors need a quiet stretch to replace the missing markers. Clear the narrow woodland approach.
Defeat 18 Rime Wolf in Thornscar Wilds.
quests.progress: There are still Rime Wolf along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: They have reached the first bend. A map improves greatly when someone can stand still to draw it.

quests.title: A Marker for the Dark
quests.npc_look: ranger woman, auburn braid, blue cloak, bow on back
intro: Pale wyvern scales will catch lantern light on the new trail posts. We need markers that show through rain.
Bring me 22 scale from Bone Wyvern in Thornscar Wilds.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the scale. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A soft gleam is enough. We are guiding travelers, not announcing a parade.

quests.title: Warmth for the Resin
quests.npc_look: ranger woman, auburn braid, blue cloak, bow on back
intro: Warm ore will keep the sealing resin workable on the cold ridge. Handle it with the thick tongs.
Bring me 26 fire ore from Cinder Centaur in Thornscar Wilds.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the fire ore. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The seals have set cleanly. We will not find these signs floating in the stream next spring.

quests.title: The Walk Back to the Lodge
quests.npc_look: ranger woman, auburn braid, blue cloak, bow on back
intro: Clear the return trail while the surveyors pack their tools. The final marker should lead them home.
Defeat 30 Moonfang Lycan in Thornscar Wilds.
quests.progress: There are still Moonfang Lycan along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: A good trail ends at a warm door. Take this for helping us make sure of it.

quests.title: A Frame for the Buoy
quests.npc_look: weathered harbor man, blue cap, burgundy coat, rope coil
intro: The wreck-channel buoy needs a light inner frame. Smooth bone pieces will float more kindly than iron.
Bring me 18 bone fragment from Bonewalker in Lantern Wreck.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the bone fragment. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Light enough to rise with the tide, strong enough to keep its shape.

quests.title: The Salvage Crew's Landing
quests.npc_look: weathered harbor man, blue cap, burgundy coat, rope coil
intro: Clear the landing so the salvage crew can carry the old bell ashore.
Defeat 22 Bone Archer in Lantern Wreck.
quests.progress: There are still Bone Archer along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: They have the bell. It has been silent for years, but its bronze is sound.

quests.title: A Lantern in the Rain
quests.npc_look: weathered harbor man, blue cap, burgundy coat, rope coil
intro: A little wisp essence will keep the buoy lamp visible through the harbor rain.
Bring me 26 ectoplasm from Wisp Wraith in Lantern Wreck.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A steady light. The crews will not need to guess at the channel mouth anymore.

quests.title: The First Safe Passage
quests.npc_look: weathered harbor man, blue cap, burgundy coat, rope coil
intro: Clear the final approach while we tow the repaired buoy into position.
Defeat 30 Bone Captain in Lantern Wreck.
quests.progress: There are still Bone Captain along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The bell is ringing over the water again. Take this with the harbor's thanks, and come in out of the rain.

quests.title: A Ticket to Repairs
quests.npc_look: young lantern boy, red raincoat, brown boots, small lantern
intro: The Wonderwheel stopped before opening day. The grown-ups need a few good gears, not another meeting.
Bring me 18 gear cog from Tick Sentinel in Wonderwheel Park.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the gear cog. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Those look much more useful than the minutes of a meeting.

quests.title: Soft Seats for Small Guests
quests.npc_look: young lantern boy, red raincoat, brown boots, small lantern
intro: The little riding seats need fresh padding. Clean toy stuffing will make the first trip comfortable.
Bring me 22 cursed doll from Stitched Bruin in Wonderwheel Park.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the cursed doll. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Soft enough for my little sister. She has very firm opinions about cushions.

quests.title: The Rainproof Ticket Box
quests.npc_look: young lantern boy, red raincoat, brown boots, small lantern
intro: The ticket box leaks whenever the sea wind brings rain. Clear gel will save the paper rolls.
Bring me 26 slime goo from Jellop in Wonderwheel Park.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the slime goo. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Dry tickets at last. We were nearly selling damp confetti.

quests.title: Before the First Turn
quests.npc_look: young lantern boy, red raincoat, brown boots, small lantern
intro: Clear the boarding path while the engineer checks the wheel. I want everyone to hear its first bell.
Defeat 30 Dread Bruin in Wonderwheel Park.
quests.progress: There are still Dread Bruin along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: It is turning! Take this, then come back before sunset. The top seat has the best view.

quests.title: Labels for the Seed Beds
quests.npc_look: farmer woman, straw hat, green overalls, seed pouch
intro: The garden labels have washed blank. Dry bark will make new ones that can stand a proper spring shower.
Bring me 12 stump bark from Stumpkin in Whisperwheat Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the stump bark. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Now the beans will not be mistaken for onions. Neither plant enjoyed that arrangement.

quests.title: A Ribbon at the Gate
quests.npc_look: farmer woman, straw hat, green overalls, seed pouch
intro: The hogs ran off with the gate ribbons. We need those bright ties to keep visitors out of the seedlings.
Bring me 16 pig ribbon from Bristle Hog in Whisperwheat Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the pig ribbon. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A cheerful gate is easier to notice than a stern little sign.

quests.title: The Seedling Shelters
quests.npc_look: farmer woman, straw hat, green overalls, seed pouch
intro: A cool night is coming. Little cap shelters will keep the tender seedlings from catching the frost.
Bring me 20 mushroom cap from Puffspore in Whisperwheat Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Every new leaf has a roof. The garden can sleep as soundly as we do.

quests.title: The Watering Path
quests.npc_look: farmer woman, straw hat, green overalls, seed pouch
intro: Clear the path to the water barrels so the evening round can finish before dark.
Defeat 24 Jellop in Whisperwheat Fields.
quests.progress: There are still Jellop along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The beds are watered. Keep this, and visit when the first supper beans are ready.

quests.title: The Cloud-Cup Rims
quests.npc_look: elderly mage man, violet robe, violet pointed hat, silver beard, staff
intro: Our observatory cups need their rough rims polished. Fine shell powder will smooth them without scratching the glaze.
Bring me 12 snail shell from Azure Snail in Gleaming Steps.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the snail shell. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Smooth enough for a weary visitor's first cup. Little comforts are worth the work.

quests.title: A Steady Tea Tray
quests.npc_look: elderly mage man, violet robe, violet pointed hat, silver beard, staff
intro: The stair wind makes the tray slide. A thin gel grip will keep the cups safely in their rings.
Bring me 16 slime goo from Jellop in Gleaming Steps.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the slime goo. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Not a rattle. I can stop walking as though the tray contains sleeping dragons.

quests.title: Shade Above the Kettle
quests.npc_look: elderly mage man, violet robe, violet pointed hat, silver beard, staff
intro: A light cap shade will shelter the outside kettle from passing cloud drizzle.
Bring me 20 mushroom cap from Puffspore in Gleaming Steps.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The kettle can steam in peace. That is an admirable ambition.

quests.title: The Guests' First Steps
quests.npc_look: elderly mage man, violet robe, violet pointed hat, silver beard, staff
intro: Clear the approach before the new star-watchers arrive. I would like their first surprise to be the view.
Defeat 24 Pebble Snail in Gleaming Steps.
quests.progress: There are still Pebble Snail along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The cups are ready and the sky is clearing. Take this for lending a hand between the clouds.

quests.title: Where the Draft Gets In
quests.npc_look: winter warden man, fur-trimmed brown coat, white hair
intro: The welcome hut is colder than the trail. A few frost samples will show which wall catches the worst draft.
Bring me 12 ice shard from Frost Cub in Snowbell Trail.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ice shard. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The north corner. I had blamed the door, which was quite unfair to it.

quests.title: A Smooth Sled Runner
quests.npc_look: winter warden man, fur-trimmed brown coat, white hair
intro: The supply sled runner is rough. Shell powder will polish it without taking too much wood away.
Bring me 16 snail shell from Azure Snail in Snowbell Trail.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the snail shell. Take your time on the trail.
complete: That will glide. Carrying firewood should not feel like pulling the whole forest.

quests.title: The Window Seal
quests.npc_look: winter warden man, fur-trimmed brown coat, white hair
intro: A flexible clear seal will keep cold air out without hiding the snowbell flowers outside.
Bring me 20 slime goo from Jellop in Snowbell Trail.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the slime goo. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A warmer window with the same lovely view. A fair bargain.

quests.title: Tiny Roofs for Snowbells
quests.npc_look: winter warden man, fur-trimmed brown coat, white hair
intro: A late frost threatens the flowers around the hut. Small cap roofs will shelter them until morning.
Bring me 24 mushroom cap from Puffspore in Snowbell Trail.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Warm guests and sheltered flowers. You have made a small corner of winter kinder. This is for you.

quests.title: A Shade for Each Lantern
quests.npc_look: elderly woman, silver bun, teal-blue shawl, cream skirt, woven basket
intro: The ricefield lanterns need fresh shades before the harvest walk. Broad caps will keep their light low and warm.
Bring me 18 mushroom cap from Mossy Cap in Jadegrain Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the mushroom cap. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The path will glow without waking the birds in the reeds.

quests.title: The Harvest Approach
quests.npc_look: elderly woman, silver bun, teal-blue shawl, cream skirt, woven basket
intro: Boars are crowding the approach where the harvest baskets pass. Give the carriers a clear stretch.
Defeat 22 Tusker Boar in Jadegrain Fields.
quests.progress: There are still Tusker Boar along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: Every basket reached the storehouse. That is a quiet sort of triumph.

quests.title: The Stolen Harvest Ties
quests.npc_look: elderly woman, silver bun, teal-blue shawl, cream skirt, woven basket
intro: The apes have carried off the pink harvest ties. Bring the recovered ribbons back before they knot them into a hammock.
Bring me 26 pig ribbon from Canopy Ape in Jadegrain Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the pig ribbon. Take your time on the trail.
complete: Still mostly straight. I have untangled worse things than an ape's idea of decoration.

quests.title: A Wish on the Evening Wind
quests.npc_look: elderly woman, silver bun, teal-blue shawl, cream skirt, woven basket
intro: Soft feathers will balance the hanging wishes so they turn gently instead of tearing in the breeze.
Bring me 30 feather from Twinhead Birk in Jadegrain Fields.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the feather. Take your time on the trail.
complete: The field lights are ready. Take this, and think of a good wish before you join the walk.

quests.title: Clips for the Ferry Awning
quests.npc_look: serene monk, dark teal robe, pale blue sash, prayer beads
intro: The ferry awning shook loose in the last squall. Strong claw clips will hold its edges through the crossing.
Bring me 18 crab claw from Reef Snapper in Lotuswater Crossing.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the crab claw. Take your time on the trail.
complete: A dry bench is a generous welcome after a wet road.

quests.title: The Waiting Steps
quests.npc_look: serene monk, dark teal robe, pale blue sash, prayer beads
intro: Clear the waiting steps while I repair the mooring rope. The passengers need somewhere safe to stand.
Defeat 22 Swamp Gator in Lotuswater Crossing.
quests.progress: There are still Swamp Gator along the approach. Return when the path is clear.
complete: The landing is quiet again. You can hear the lotus leaves brushing the water.

quests.title: The Mooring Seal
quests.npc_look: serene monk, dark teal robe, pale blue sash, prayer beads
intro: A coat of flexible resin will protect the fresh rope where it rests against the quay.
Bring me 26 ectoplasm from Tide Inkling in Lotuswater Crossing.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the ectoplasm. Take your time on the trail.
complete: That should last through many crossings. I prefer repairs that give us time to watch the river.

quests.title: The Dusk Reflector
quests.npc_look: serene monk, dark teal robe, pale blue sash, prayer beads
intro: A few bright fish scales will restore the little reflector on the last ferry lamp.
Bring me 30 scale from Gloomfin in Lotuswater Crossing.
quests.progress: I still need the rest of the scale. Take your time on the trail.
complete: There: one clear light across the dusk. Take this, and wave if you pass us on the water.
